newsitem.title: USA: Eltron says rumors hurt stock price.
newsitem.headline: Eltron says rumors hurt stock price.

text.p: Eltron International Inc said Friday it believes a marked decline in its share price was due to rumors following the termination of merger talks with Zebra Technologies Corp last month.
Eltron did not specify the nature of the rumors.
In a press release, the company said its relationship with healthy and non-UPS business was growing at a rate better than 50 percent.
Eltron said sales out of its new office in Singapore had been better than expected and an accelerating growth rate was expected for sales in the Far East and China for 1997.
Later, an Eltron spokeswoman said the rumors about the company concerned competition and price wars.
Eltron was up 3/4 to 21-1/4 in afternoon trade.
